# Pull request

## Summary

Describe the problem, the smallest correct change, and any user-visible behavior.

## Validation

List the exact commands and manual checks used to validate this change.

## Security and privacy

- [ ] The change preserves least privilege and read-only repository access.
- [ ] Tests and examples contain no live credentials or private repository data.
- [ ] New data collection, retention, network access, or permissions are documented.

## Contribution disclosure

- [ ] I reviewed and understand every submitted change.
- [ ] I disclosed material AI assistance in the commit or pull request description.
